## Overview: Two Ways to Use `glmap`

`glmap` supports **two complementary APIs** on top of the exact same C++17 + WebGL2 + MapLibre GL engine:

1. **Zero-Rewrite `leaflet` Compatibility API (`camelCase`)**:
   - Exported directly by `library(glmap)` (`leaflet()`, `addTiles()`, `addProviderTiles()`, `addMarkers()`, `addAwesomeMarkers()`, `addCircleMarkers()`, `addPolygons()`, `addPolylines()`, `addCircles()`, `addRectangles()`, `addRasterImage()`, `addLegend()`, `addLayersControl()`, `colorNumeric()`, `colorBin()`, `colorQuantile()`, `colorFactor()`, `leafletOutput()`, `renderLeaflet()`, `leafletProxy()`, and `%>%`).
   - Existing R scripts, Quarto/RMarkdown reports, and Shiny apps written for `leaflet` and `leaflet.extras` run on the GPU simply by replacing `library(leaflet)` with `library(glmap)`.
2. **Idiomatic `glmap` API (`snake_case`)**:
   - Designed for concise new code and AI coding agents (`glmap()`, `add_points()`, `add_polygons()`, `add_lines()`, `add_raster()`, `add_hexbin()`, `add_heatmap()`, `add_duckdb()`, `glmapOutput()`, `renderGlmap()`, `glmap_proxy()`).
   - Eliminates `colorNumeric()` and `addLegend()` boilerplate by accepting `color = ~col, palette = "viridis"` directly.

---

## 1. Zero-Rewrite Drop-In Example

The following classic `leaflet` + `leaflet.extras` script runs **unchanged** with `library(glmap)`:

```{r}
# Simply swap library(leaflet) for library(glmap)
library(glmap)
library(sf)

nc <- sf::st_read(system.file("shape/nc.shp", package = "sf"), quiet = TRUE)
nc <- sf::st_transform(nc, 4326)

bins <- c(0, 1000, 2000, 3500, 5000, 8000, 15000, Inf)
pal <- colorBin("YlOrRd", domain = nc$BIR74, bins = bins)

leaflet(nc) %>%
  addProviderTiles(providers$CartoDB.Positron, group = "Positron") %>%
  addTiles(group = "OSM") %>%
  addPolygons(
    fillColor = ~pal(BIR74),
    weight = 1.5,
    opacity = 1,
    color = "white",
    fillOpacity = 0.75,
    highlightOptions = highlightOptions(
      weight = 3,
      color = "#0f172a",
      fillOpacity = 0.85,
      bringToFront = TRUE
    ),
    label = ~paste0(NAME, ": ", BIR74),
    group = "Counties"
  ) %>%
  addLegend(
    "bottomright",
    pal = pal,
    values = ~BIR74,
    title = "Births (1974)",
    opacity = 0.85
  ) %>%
  addLayersControl(
    baseGroups = c("Positron", "OSM"),
    overlayGroups = c("Counties"),
    options = layersControlOptions(collapsed = FALSE)
  ) %>%
  addMiniMap(width = 140, height = 110, position = "bottomleft") %>%
  addMeasure(position = "bottomleft")
```

---

## 2. Complete Legacy `leaflet` $\rightarrow$ `glmap` Function Call Mapping

### A. Map Initialization, Camera & Basemaps

| Legacy `leaflet` Call | Exported Alias in `glmap` | Idiomatic `glmap` Call | Notes |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `leaflet(data, width, height)` | `leaflet(data, width, height)` | `glmap(data, basemap = "positron")` | `glmap()` auto-adds a default layer if no `add_*()` is piped |
| `addTiles(urlTemplate, group)` | `addTiles(urlTemplate, group)` | `set_basemap("osm")` | Also registers `group` in the base layer switcher |
| `addProviderTiles(provider, group, options)` | `addProviderTiles(provider, group, options)` | `add_provider_tiles(provider, api_key)` | Supports `providers$CartoDB.Positron`, `providers$Esri.WorldImagery`, etc. |
| `addWMSTiles(baseUrl, layers, options)` | `addWMSTiles(baseUrl, layers, options)` | `add_wms_tiles(base_url, layers)` | Uses `{bbox-epsg-3857}` OGC WMS tile requests |
| `setView(lng, lat, zoom)` | `setView(lng, lat, zoom)` | `set_view(lng, lat, zoom, pitch, bearing)` | Supports 3D camera `pitch` and `bearing` |
| `fitBounds(lng1, lat1, lng2, lat2)` | `fitBounds(lng1, lat1, lng2, lat2)` | `fit_bounds(c(xmin, ymin, xmax, ymax))` | Accepts 4 arguments (including formulas `~min(long)`), bbox vector, `sf`, or `SpatRaster` |
| `flyTo(lng, lat, zoom)` | `flyTo(lng, lat, zoom)` | `fly_to(lng, lat, zoom, pitch, bearing)` | Smooth WebGL camera flight |
| `flyToBounds(lng1, lat1, lng2, lat2)` | `flyToBounds(...)` | `fly_to_bounds(bbox)` | Smooth animated bounds transition |
| `setMaxBounds(lng1, lat1, lng2, lat2)` | `setMaxBounds(...)` | `set_max_bounds(bbox)` | Constrains camera pan bounds |

### B. Markers, Icons, Clusters & Labels

| Legacy `leaflet` Call | Exported Alias in `glmap` | Idiomatic `glmap` Call | Notes |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `addCircleMarkers(lng, lat, radius, color, fillColor, fillOpacity, layerId)` | `addCircleMarkers(...)` | `add_points(lon, lat, radius, color, palette, opacity, layerId)` | Rendered via WebGL2 instanced SDF circle shader (`radius` in pixels) |
| `addMarkers(lng, lat, icon, popup, label, clusterOptions)` | `addMarkers(...)` | `add_markers(lng, lat, icon, popup, label, clusterOptions)` | 3-mode GPU Icon Engine (`atlas`, `cluster` with spiderfy web, `lod`) |
| `makeIcon(iconUrl, iconWidth, iconHeight)` | `makeIcon(...)` / `icons(...)` | `make_icon(iconUrl, iconWidth, iconHeight)` | Automatic `crossOrigin = "anonymous"` GPU Texture Atlas packing |
| `iconList(...)` | `iconList(...)` | `icon_list(...)` | Supports `~oceanIcons[type]` subsetting |
| `addAwesomeMarkers(lng, lat, icon)` | `addAwesomeMarkers(...)` | `add_markers(lng, lat, icon)` | Packs multi-color badge pins into GPU sprite sheet |
| `makeAwesomeIcon(...)` / `awesomeIcons(...)` | `makeAwesomeIcon(...)` / `awesomeIcons(...)` | `make_awesome_icon(...)` / `awesome_icons(...)` | Supports vectorized `markerColor = c("green", "orange", "red")` |
| `markerClusterOptions(...)` | `markerClusterOptions(...)` | `marker_cluster_options(...)` | Includes automatic spiderfy web expansion on co-located coordinates |
| `addLabelOnlyMarkers(lng, lat, label)` | `addLabelOnlyMarkers(...)` | `add_labels(lon, lat, text)` | Crisp halo-outlined text labels |
| `addPopups(lng, lat, popup, layerId)` | `addPopups(...)` | `add_popups(lon, lat, popup)` | Supports standalone popups and Shiny proxy click popups |
| `clearPopups(map)` | `clearPopups(map)` | `clear_popups(map)` | Closes active floating popup card |

### C. Polygons, Lines, Geodesic Circles, Rectangles & Rasters

| Legacy `leaflet` Call | Exported Alias in `glmap` | Idiomatic `glmap` Call | Notes |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `addPolygons(fillColor, fillOpacity, color, weight, fill, highlightOptions)` | `addPolygons(...)` | `add_polygons(fill_color, palette, fill_opacity, line_color, line_width, highlightOptions)` | C++17 `GLMap/earstrip` zero-copy triangulation (with CDT fallback) |
| `addPolylines(color, weight, opacity)` | `addPolylines(...)` | `add_lines(color, palette, width, opacity)` | Multi-ring segment index buffer |
| `addCircles(lng, lat, radius, fillColor, layerId)` | `addCircles(...)` | `add_circles(lon, lat, radius, fill_color, layerId)` | `radius` in **meters** on the ground (geodesic 24-segment polygon rings) |
| `addRectangles(lng1, lat1, lng2, lat2)` | `addRectangles(...)` | `add_rectangles(lng1, lat1, lng2, lat2)` | Bounding-box polygons |
| `addRasterImage(x, colors, opacity)` | `addRasterImage(...)` | `add_raster(raster, palette, opacity, hillshade, shader_controls)` | Streams raw `Float32` texture (`RGBA32F`) to GPU fragment shader |

### D. Color Palettes, Legends & Interactive Controls

| Legacy `leaflet` / `leaflet.extras` Call | Exported Alias in `glmap` | Idiomatic `glmap` Call | Notes |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `colorNumeric(palette, domain)` | `colorNumeric(...)` | `color_numeric(...)` (or `color = ~col`) | Preserves `"colorType"` and `"colorArgs"` attributes for `addLegend()` |
| `colorBin(palette, domain, bins)` | `colorBin(...)` | `color_bin(...)` | Supports numeric bin count or explicit cut vector |
| `colorQuantile(palette, domain, n)` | `colorQuantile(...)` | `color_quantile(...)` | Equal-count quantile bins |
| `colorFactor(palette, domain, levels)` | `colorFactor(...)` | `color_factor(...)` | Categorical level mapping |
| `labelFormat(prefix, suffix, between, digits)` | `labelFormat(...)` | `label_format(...)` | Custom legend label formatter |
| `addLegend(position, pal, values, title)` | `addLegend(...)` | `add_legend(...)` | Automatic in idiomatic `glmap` when `color = ~col` is used |
| `addLayersControl(baseGroups, overlayGroups, options)` | `addLayersControl(...)` | `add_layers_control(...)` | Includes live **Marker / Icon Engine** switcher |
| `addMiniMap(width, height, position)` | `addMiniMap(...)` | `add_minimap(...)` | Synchronized overview canvas with orange aiming rectangle |
| `addMeasure(position, primaryLengthUnit, primaryAreaUnit)` | `addMeasure(...)` | `add_measure(...)` | Geodesic path distance & spherical-excess polygon area |
| `addGraticule(interval)` / `addSimpleGraticule()` | `addGraticule(...)` / `addSimpleGraticule(...)` | `add_graticule(...)` / `add_simple_graticule(...)` | WebGL meridian/parallel grid |
| `addTerminator(resolution, time)` | `addTerminator(...)` | `add_terminator(...)` | Solar day/night hemisphere polygon |
| `addDrawToolbar(...)` / `removeDrawToolbar(...)` | `addDrawToolbar(...)` / `removeDrawToolbar(...)` | `add_draw_toolbar(...)` / `remove_draw_toolbar(...)` | Emits `_draw_new_feature`, `_draw_deleted_features`, `_draw_all_features` |
| `addSearchOSM(options)` | `addSearchOSM(...)` | `add_search_osm(...)` | OpenStreetMap Nominatim geocoder |

### E. Shiny UI, Server, Proxy & Reactive Input Events

| Legacy `leaflet` Pattern | Exported Alias in `glmap` | Idiomatic `glmap` Pattern |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `leafletOutput("map", width, height)` | `leafletOutput("map", width, height)` | `glmapOutput("map", width, height)` |
| `renderLeaflet({ ... })` | `renderLeaflet({ ... })` | `renderGlmap({ ... })` |
| `leafletProxy("map", session, data)` | `leafletProxy("map", session, data)` | `glmap_proxy("map", session, data)` |
| `showGroup("g")` / `hideGroup("g")` / `clearGroup("g")` | `showGroup("g")` / `hideGroup("g")` / `clearGroup("g")` | `show_group("g")` / `hide_group("g")` / `clear_group("g")` |
| `clearShapes()` / `clearMarkers()` / `clearControls()` | `clearShapes()` / `clearMarkers()` / `clearControls()` | `clear_shapes()` / `clear_markers()` / `clear_controls()` |
| `removeShape(id)` / `removeMarker(id)` | `removeShape(id)` / `removeMarker(id)` | `remove_shape(id)` / `remove_marker(id)` / `clear_layer(id)` |
| `input$map_click` | `list(lng, lat, raster_value, nonce)` | Identical |
| `input$map_bounds` | `list(west, south, east, north)` (emitted on load & `moveend`) | Identical |
| `input$map_zoom` / `input$map_center` | Current zoom number & `list(lng, lat)` | Identical |
| `input$map_shape_click` / `input$map_marker_click` | `list(id, featureIndex, layerId, group, lng, lat)` | Honors vectorized `layerId = ~col` |
| `input$map_groups` | Character vector of active base + overlay groups | Identical |
